content:
# graph-manager: cached run views and the "Review + live test" card list every reviewer of the run

## What to build

Already in the codebase (engine slices): a run page's `GET /state` (the engine's `ViewState`, proxied by graph-manager at `/runs/<ws>/<runId>/view/state` and snapshotted every 3 s into `<dataDir>/views/<ws>/<runId>.json` by `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.ts`) now carries
- `reviewers: { id: string; agent: string; node: string; title: string }[]` — one entry per enabled reviewer of the run, in order (built-ins: `{ id: "code", agent: "reviewer", node: "@reviewer", title: "code reviewer" }`, `{ id: "tester", agent: "tester", node: "@tester", title: "live tester" }`; a file reviewer: `{ id: "security", agent: "security", node: "@security", title: "Security" }`); empty when the run has no enabled reviewer;
- `agents[<agent>]` — a `NodeView` (`status`, `attempt`, `attempts`, `startedAt`, `endedAt`, `label`, …) for each pipeline agent (`gateFixer`, `reviewer`, `tester`, `fixer`) AND for each other reviewer agent (`agents.security`);
- `summary.reports[]` — each `{ round, reviewer: <reviewer id>, findings: [{ id, severity: "blocker"|"major"|"minor", status: "open"|"fixed"|"not_fixed", … }], … }` once the run is over.

Old snapshots (before this feature) have no `reviewers` field and only `agents.reviewer` / `agents.tester`.

This slice stops graph-manager from hard-coding `reviewer`/`tester` (spec `docs/prd/ui-reviewers.md`, last bullet of "graph-manager: storage and API"; KAN-87): the cached view records every reviewer of the run with its status and finding counts, and the run detail page's **Review + live test** phase card lists each reviewer with its status and counts. Old cached views keep rendering exactly as today.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.ts`:
  - lines 13-47 `CachedNode`, `CachedView` (line 35 `agents: Partial<Record<"gateFixer" | "reviewer" | "tester" | "fixer", CachedNode>>`);
  - line 49 `const AGENTS = ["gateFixer", "reviewer", "tester", "fixer"] as const;`;
  - lines 56-111 the tolerant `nodeSchema` / `snapshotSchema` (`agents: z.record(z.string(), nodeSchema)`, `summary.reports: z.array(z.object({ findings: z.array(z.unknown()).catch([]) }).passthrough())`);
  - lines 135-185 `toCachedView` (agents loop at 143-147; `summary.findings` total at 163-167; `testPlan` from `agents.tester` at 178-182).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.test.ts` lines 1-80 (`snapshot()` factory and expectations; keep them passing).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` line 157 (`Object.values(view.agents).some(...)` → "review failed"; works unchanged with more agents).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runs.ts` lines 19-55 — the web copy of `CachedNode`/`CachedView` types (keep in sync with the server's).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PhaseCards.tsx` (whole file, ~150 lines) — `phaseCards(detail, fullPath)`; "Review + live test" at lines 68-85 (`stepOf(view?.agents.reviewer)`, `stepOf(view?.agents.tester)`, detail `"reviewer + tester"`); `PhaseCards` component renders `title`, `status`, `detail`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.css` lines 46-58 (`.phase-cards`, `.phase-card*` styles, tokens).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx` lines 165-240 (the applied run fixture with `agents: { reviewer, tester, fixer }` and `expect(screen.getByTestId("phase-review").textContent).toContain("passed · 3 findings")`).

## Patterns to follow

- The cache schema is **tolerant**: unknown fields pass, broken optional ones drop (`.optional().catch(undefined)`); never throw on an unexpected snapshot shape.
- `PhaseCard` stays a plain data object computed by the pure `phaseCards()`; the component only renders it. `data-testid` on new elements.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.ts`

- `CachedView`: add `/** Every reviewer of the run, in order; absent in views cached before KAN-87. */ reviewers?: CachedReviewer[];` with
  ```ts
  export type CachedReviewer = { id: string; title: string; node: CachedNode; findings?: { blocker: number; major: number; minor: number } };
  ```
  and widen `agents` to `Partial<Record<string, CachedNode>>` (the four pipeline keys still appear as today).
- `snapshotSchema`: add `reviewers: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), agent: z.string(), node: z.string(), title: z.string() }).passthrough()).optional().catch(undefined)`; let `summary.reports` items keep `reviewer: z.string().optional().catch(undefined)` and findings as `z.array(z.object({ severity: z.string().optional().catch(undefined), status: z.string().optional().catch(undefined) }).passthrough()).catch([])` (still counts all for `summary.findings`).
- `toCachedView`:
  - agents: keep the four `AGENTS` and also copy every agent named by `s.reviewers[].agent` (`errorOf(r.node)` for its error).
  - `reviewers`: when `s.reviewers` is present, `view.reviewers = s.reviewers.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, title: r.title, node: agents[r.agent] ?? { status: "pending" }, ...(counts ? { findings: counts } : {}) }))` where `counts` are the open findings (`status !== "fixed"`) of the summary report with `reviewer === r.id`, by severity (unknown severities ignored); no summary → no `findings`.
  - `testPlan`: from the reviewer whose `id === "tester"` (agent `tester`), as today.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runs.ts`

- Mirror the type changes (`CachedReviewer`, `reviewers?`, widened `agents`).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PhaseCards.tsx`

- `PhaseCard`: add `rows?: { id: string; name: string; status: string; tone: Tone; counts?: string }[]`.
- Review card:
  - `const list = view?.reviewers ?? legacy` where `legacy` = `[ { id: "code", title: "code reviewer", node: view.agents.reviewer }, { id: "tester", title: "live tester", node: view.agents.tester } ]` filtered to entries whose node exists (today's behaviour for old views).
  - Aggregate step over `list.map((r) => stepOf(r.node))` with today's rules (any failed → failed, any running → running, any passed → passed, else landed ? passed : not reached). With `view.reviewers` present and empty: status `skipped`, detail `no reviewers enabled`.
  - `detail`: the names joined with ` + ` (`code reviewer + live tester` / `Code review + Live test + Security`), or `—` when not reached. (The existing test only checks `status`; keep `passed · N findings`.)
  - `rows`: one per reviewer with `name = title`, `status = stepOf(node)`, `tone = TONE[step]`, `counts = findings ? \`${findings.blocker} blocker · ${findings.major} major · ${findings.minor} minor\` : undefined`; only set when `view.reviewers` is present (old views: no rows, unchanged DOM).
- `PhaseCards` component: when `c.rows` is set, render under the detail `<ul className="phase-card-rows" data-testid={\`phase-${c.key}-rows\`}>` with one `<li data-testid={\`phase-reviewer-${r.id}\`}>` per row: a status glyph (`glyph glyph-${GLYPH[r.tone]} tone-${r.tone}`), the name, the status, and `counts` in `mono`.
- `RunDetail.css`: `.phase-card-rows` (list reset, `gap: 2px`, 11px text, `color: var(--fg2)`, each `li` one line with ellipsis, no horizontal overflow at 800 px).

### Tests

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.test.ts`: a snapshot with `reviewers` (code, tester, security), `agents.security = node("failed")`, `failures["@security"]`, and `summary.reports` with a security report `[{severity:"major",status:"open"},{severity:"minor",status:"open"},{severity:"blocker",status:"fixed"}]` → `view.reviewers[2]` is `{ id: "security", title: "Security", node: { status: "failed", …, error }, findings: { blocker: 0, major: 1, minor: 1 } }` and `view.agents.security` exists; the existing snapshot without `reviewers` → no `reviewers` key (existing expectations unchanged).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PhaseCards.test.ts` (new, node env, pure `phaseCards`): with three reviewers (`code` done, `tester` done, `security` failed) → review card status `failed`, detail `Code review + Live test + Security`, rows with tones `ok`/`ok`/`bad` and security counts `0 blocker · 1 major · 1 minor`; empty `reviewers: []` on an applied run → status `skipped`, detail `no reviewers enabled`; legacy view (agents only) → no `rows`, detail `code reviewer + live tester`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx`: existing cases pass unchanged; add one applied run whose `view.reviewers` has a Security entry and assert `phase-reviewer-security` shows `Security`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A run with `code`, `tester` and `security` shows three rows in the Review + live test card, each with its status and `N blocker · N major · N minor` once the run is over.
- [ ] Old cached views and runs without `reviewers` render exactly as before.
- [ ] A run with no enabled reviewer shows the card as `skipped` · `no reviewers enabled`.
- [ ] A failed `@security` makes the run's failure line "review failed" (already true via `view.agents`).
- [ ] No horizontal scroll on the run detail page at 800 px.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- viewcache PhaseCards RunDetail runs
npm test
```
